pages.name: Unexpected Bather
pages.description: It seems the little flounder was drawn into the pool along with the seawater. Now it lies on a wet stone beside the drainage channel, moving its gills. There is still water in the bucket nearby.

options.description: Pour out the water and wash the flounder into the pool
Put the flounder in the bucket

pages.name: Back in the Water
pages.description: The stream from the bucket catches the flounder and carries it over the low rim. The fish pauses on the bottom for a moment, then disappears into the deeper part of the pool.

scenePatch.description: No one remains on the wet stone. A flat shadow sometimes flickers in the clear seawater.

pages.name: Flounder in a Bucket
pages.description: The flounder fits neatly across the width of the bucket. There is enough water to carry your unexpected find home.

scenePatch.description: Only a wet stone remains beside the drainage channel.
